title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1973-11-11
lineage: Nakamichi CR-7A > Tascam DA-3000 @ 24 bit 96 kHz
source: dead center 10 rows back with a Sony ECM-22P mic (mono)> Sony TC-55 > BASF C90 master cassettes

ai_review.summary: Stunning late‑1973 Winterland show with a surprise vocal burst into the finale and solid audience recording
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this performance, highlighting the magical moment at the end when Bob says goodnight and Garcia launches an unexpected vocal into the closing jam – calling it one of the best shows of ’73.  No specific technical complaints are made, suggesting the audience tape is listenable enough to let the music shine.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews give 5‑star ratings and focus on the musical high points; with only two brief comments, recording quality cannot be fully assessed but no issues are noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit remarks about clarity or mix; reviewers did not mention drop‑outs or muffiness, implying the tape is at least listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show builds to a memorable finale where Garcia surprises the band with vocals, creating an uplifting close.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s surprise vocal into the final jam is highlighted as a standout moment.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir’s good‑night shout is noted as part of the memorable ending.
